history: Haikou means 'mouth of the Nandu River'; it was already a Qiongzhou stronghold in Song times, and the Maritime Silk Road passed here in the Ming era. The arcade old streets carry a century of Southeast-Asian style; the Volcano Park shows a ten-thousand-year geological wonder. As the core of the Hainan Free Trade Port, it is warm all year under coconut palms.
importance: Capital of Hainan · Gateway of the Free Trade Port · Coconut City
foods: White-cut chicken with chicken-oil rice — the original Wenchang flavor.
Coconut-milk qing bu liang — the king of night-market coolers.
Pickled thin noodles with beef jerky and peanuts.
Fresh coconut broth, light and sweet.
Sour-spicy seafood pot of Puqian vinegar dregs.
Glutinous rice steamed in a coconut shell.
Full-roe crab steamed in its own flavor.
scenes: A century of Southeast-Asian style arcades.
Coconut avenue by a silver beach.
An extinct crater and lava tunnels, ten thousand years old.
Memorial shrines of the 'Five Lords' exiled here in Song times.
Relics linked to the 'Nanhai One' shipwreck.
Seaside green space in the city center.
Film studios of '1942 Street' and the Nanyang quarter.
